entities.name: Ferenc Szombathelyi

entities.summary: Ferenc Szombathelyi, born Ferenc Knausz or Ferenc Knauz, was a Hungarian military officer who served, from September 1941 to April 1944, as Head of the General Staff of the Royal Hungarian Army during World War II.
